disposition_reason: Ni, Cr, Cu, Cd and Pb were measured by AAS in 54 vendor-sliced watermelons from three Akure markets; Cd and Pb were not detected in any sample.

study.design: Market survey of vendor-sliced watermelon from six vendors in each of three Akure markets, with whole fruit as control
study.market: Isinkan, Shasha and Oja-Oba markets, Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria
study.method: Homogenized fruit (30 mL aliquots) digested with HNO3 then HCl:HNO3 1:3 on hotplate; flame AAS (ZA-3300)
study.qa: Reagent blanks only; no CRM or recovery reported

controls.comparator: whole watermelon cut in the laboratory (control)
controls.outcome: Ni 0.20-1.42 mg/kg in sliced fruit vs 0.27 mg/kg control; Cr up to 0.23 mg/kg vs not detected in control; Cd and Pb not detected in either

regulatory_or_exposure.what: WHO permissible limits used for comparison (as cited)

unresolved: No detection limits stated, so non-detects for Cd and Pb cannot be bounded.
Text for Shasha says Cr detected from 0.07 (vendor C) upward, but Table 2 prints 0.04 for vendor B; table recorded.
Whether the control watermelon came from the same markets is not stated.
